A timeline showing the key milestones of Nigerian decolonization from left to right. 1922: Clifford Constitution (Elective principle introduced). 1923: NNDP formed. 1944: NCNC formed. 1945: General Strike. 1954: Lyttelton Constitution (Federalism introduced). 1957/1959: Regional Self-Government. 1960: Independence. Style: clean flat textbook illustration, white background, distinct timeline nodes.
